request: Mirror the part according to the plane lying on the not rounded end of the part. Merge the mirrored part together with the existing one so they create one body.

actions.operation: Mirror (create mirrored copy of the part/body)

parameters.mirror_plane_definition: Use the planar end face at the not-rounded end (square end face) as the mirror plane
parameters.mirror_mode: Create new body (do not delete original)
parameters.merge_result: No (mirror first, union in next step)

actions.relational_constraint: Mirror according to the plane lying on the not rounded end of the part (mirror plane coincident with that end plane/face)
actions.unresolved_reference: Resolved: the 'not rounded end' corresponds to the square end face of the main bar.
steps: Identify the not-rounded end from multiviews: the bar shows one rounded planform end and one flat/square termination; select the planar square termination face.
In model.json this mirror reference is Section S1 'Main bar (prismatic body)' major face 'Square end face' with face_code '0004' (Brep_id 'FACE 7').

Set/create a datum plane coincident with face_code '0004' (FACE 7). Ensure plane normal is along the bar length direction (normal to the end face) so the mirror produces an end-to-end symmetric duplicate.
Run Mirror on the entire solid body (all sections S1/S2/S3/S4/S5). Choose 'copy' / 'new body' option so the original remains and a mirrored solid is generated across the selected plane.

Verify the mirrored body is exactly coincident with the original at the mirror interface: the square end face becomes the shared contact interface between original and mirrored solids (co-planar, overlapping).
If the CAD system offers 'Merge solids' within Mirror, keep it OFF here to preserve a controlled boolean union step next (per operation list).

actions.relational_constraint: Merge together with the existing one so they create one body (result must be a single solid body)
actions.unresolved_reference: Resolved: merge includes exactly the original solid and the newly created mirrored solid; union is intended across the coincident interface at the mirror plane.
steps: Select both solids: (1) the original solid body and (2) the mirrored copy created in the previous action.
Execute Boolean Union (Merge) to form a single solid body.

Confirm the join occurs across the coincident planar interface defined by face_code '0004' (FACE 7); the internal coincident faces should be consumed/removed by the union, yielding one watertight solid.

Validate the result: body count = 1; no gaps at the mirror plane; the model now has mirrored geometry end-to-end, including the bar, rounded end, boss, blend, and blind bore features replicated in the mirrored half.

intention: Create a symmetric version of the part about the end plane at the not-rounded (square) end and ensure the result is a single unified solid body.
